title: Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix Manga's Future Arc Gets Stage Play in February
content:
Osamu Tezuka 's Phoenix ( Hi no Tori ) manga is inspiring another stage play that will run at Sakura Hall in Shibuya Cultural Centre Owada in Tokyo from February 6-8. The play Hi no Tori Mirai-hen ZEROMDISTANCE ( Phoenix Future Arc ZEROMDISTANCE) adapts the manga's "Future" arc.

The play stars Jutta Yuki as Masato, Narumi Yasuda as the voice of the Phoenix , Moro Morooka as Dr. Saruta, Adone Kudō and Shiina Yuzuki as Tamami, and Kaiki Ohara as Rock.

Ryusei Kudoh is directing and writing the play. He is also serving as executive producer. Ryo Oguri is producing. Nao'ymt is handling the music.

Tezuka wrote Phoenix 's "Future" arc between December 1967 and September 1968. The official Osamu Tezuka website describes the second part:

Set in A.D. 3404, the earth is dying, and human beings inhabit a city-state built deep under the ground. The authorities search for Yamanobe Masato, Class 2 space warrior of Megalopolis Yamato. They suspect him of hiding Tamami, a girl transformed into a human from her original form as the outer space creature Moopie. Masato and Tamami escape over deserted land to flee from their country. Guided by the Phoenix , they arrive at Dr. Saruta's dome. Here, Dr. Saruta conducts research on artificial life with the aim of bringing extinct creatures back. Meanwhile, the final war of the human race begins in the underground city, and humans become extinct.

The manga recently inspired a stage play that ran at Theatre West at the Tokyo Metropolitan Theater in July 2024. The play was based on the manga's "Karma" arc ("Hō-ō-hen," or literally "Firebird Arc")

Phoenix inspired a live manga performance Mangalogue: Hi no Tori that ran from April 22-May 16 at MoN Takanawa: The Museum of Narratives' Box1000 theaters.

Tezuka continued to serialize new arcs for the manga until the 12th part, "Sun," which ended in 1988, the year before his death. The stories presented in the Phoenix manga span multiple eras, past and future.

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga. The first Deluxe Edition print volume includes the "Dawn" and "Future" arcs.

Viz Media previously published the manga in North America.

The four-episode Phoenix: Eden17 anime based on the manga debuted worldwide on Disney+ in September 2023. The anime's Japanese title is Hi no Tori: Eden no Sora (literally, Phoenix : Eden's Space). The anime also got a film version in November 2023 titled Phoenix: Reminiscence of Flower ( Hi no Tori: Eden no Hana , literally "Eden's Flower"). The film features a different ending from the Phoenix: Eden17 anime. The anime is based on the "Nostalgia" arc of the original manga.

The manga also inspired a series of anime film and OVA adaptations from 1978 to 1987, each adapting a different story in the manga. The manga inspired a 2004 television anime.

title: Kagurabachi Confirms End Date for Anime World Tour With Final Stops Revealed
content:
Kagurabachi has been in the midst of a world tour where the anime has been sharing the first episode before anywhere else, and now a date has been set for its grand finale with the final stops on the tour revealed. Takeru Hokazono’s Kagurabachi manga is now celebrating its 3rd anniversary of its original debut with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and it’s going to go all out with the highly anticipated release of its upcoming anime adaptation next year.

Kagurabachi has been on a world tour for the past few months across major events and countries where lucky fans in attendance had been treated to the early premiere of the anime’s very first episode. But as one of the major updates shared during Shueisha’s latest Jump Press livestream this week , Kagurabachi has now confirmed that it’s going to round out the World Tour with a few more stops before it ends in Japan next March.

Kagurabachi World Tour to End in Japan March 2027

As detailed via press release, the Kagurabachi World Tour is expanding with a Part 3 that will take it to some big new locations over the rest of the year with planned stops at AFA Singapore on November 29th, a stop over in Seoul planned for December 6th, and a stop at CCXP Brazil with no date or time confirmed for it thus far. The tour has been going across multiple countries and events since it kicked off earlier this July, and will be wrapping up with some huge plans for its own world premiere screening when it finally comes back to Japan.

The finale for the Kagurabachi World Tour Event will be taking place on Thursday, March 25 in Japan, and will not only feature the world premiere of the first full episode (instead of just 20 minutes as seen with the other stops) but the second episode as well. It’s also teased that members of the production staff and voice cast will also be in attendance for this grand finale, and that makes a ton of sense considering the actual premiere of the anime series will be coming soon after some time in April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule.

When Does Kagurabachi’ s Anime Come Out?

Kagurabachi is now scheduled for a release sometime in April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. While no concrete release date has been announced for the series as of this time, it has been confirmed to be streaming with Crunchyroll outside of Japan when it hits. The anime will be directed by Tetsuya Takeuchi for Cypic (who provided a special illustration for the manga’s third anniversary you can check out above) with Keigo Sasaki providing the character designs, but there are still many secrets being kept about how the new series has been coming along thus far.

Kagurabachi will be revealing even more soon enough as not only can fans look forward to more of this world tour, but the franchise has been confirmed to be one of the many titles with something to showcase as part of Jump Festa 2027 later this December . This would likely be the best time for a major update for the anime outside of the coming world tour stops, so hopefully we’ll get something big then. Are you going to try and make it to one of these final Kagurabachi world tour stops? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Texas' Kawacon Anime, Gaming Convention Ends After 5 Years
content:
The staff of the convention did not announce a reason but did make a statement:

To our Kawacon family, After much consideration and with heavy hearts, we have made the difficult decision to cease Kawacon operations for the foreseeable future. Over the past five years, Kawacon has grown into something far beyond what we originally imagined. What started as a vision became a thriving community that brought thousands of people together through their shared love of fandom, creativity, and connection. From our very first event to Kawacon 5, every year brought unforgettable memories, lasting friendships, and experiences we will always cherish. We are incredibly proud of everything we accomplished together. To our attendees, artists, exhibitors, guests, volunteers, staff, sponsors, and everyone who supported us along the way: Thank you. Your passion and dedication made Kawacon what it became, and we couldn't have done it without you. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for believing in our vision, growing alongside us, and making these past five years so special. Until we meet again. - The Kawacon Team

The first Kawacon event took place in February 2026.

title: New The Apothecary Diaries Movie Trailer Reveals First Look at New Characters – Watch
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is making its way to the big screen later this year with a new movie , and a new teaser trailer has now revealed the first look at some of the new characters coming our way soon. The Apothecary Diaries has been one of the most popular anime adaptations of the last few years. Following the end of the second season, it was announced that the franchise would continue with both a third season and feature film release. Now both of these projects are in motion.

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure is a brand new feature film release telling an original story not seen in Hyuga Natsu’s original novels and the creator is adding some new characters to the mix for the occasion. With Jinshi and Maomao tasked with heading to a new region in order to fulfill the last wishes of a late concubine, a new teaser trailer for the movie has revealed the voice cast behind some of the new characters making their respective debuts.

The Apothecary Diaries Movie Confirms New Voice Cast With New Teaser

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure has now revealed more of the new cast members fleshing out the Bi Clan that will be introduced in the new movie. Following the previously confirmed reveal of Mariya Ise as Mu Qing, this new teaser trailer has now confirmed Nobuo Tobita as the head of the clan Biro, Kumiko Watanabe as Biro’s wide Shuu, and Hirofumi Nojima as the oldest son Bisen. More new characters will be revealed in the coming days, so it’s certainly something new to look forward to as the film gets closer to its launch .

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure will first be hitting theaters across Japan on December 11th, and thankfully it has also been confirmed that Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will be bringing the film to theaters in North America at a later date. No confirmed date has been confirmed for its international launch as of this time, but it will be directed by Norihiro Naganuma for TOHO Animation STUDIO. It’s also going to feature a brand new story from the original creator themselves, so it won’t interfere too much with the ongoing TV anime.

Where to Catch Up With The Apothecary Diaries

The Apothecary Diaries is back on TV screens this Fall with the highly anticipated third season of the anime, and it has been confirmed to run for 24 episodes in total . The first cour will be wrapping up its run later this year, but then there will be a break in between before the series comes back to finish out the third season next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. And this new season has already sparked a much bigger mystery that Maomao and Jinshi need to get to the bottom of.

If you wanted to catch up with everything that’s released thus far, you can find The Apothecary Diaries now streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll in the meantime. An English dub release is planned for the third season’s episodes, but a release date has for it has yet to be confirmed. But there’s also a new live-action series and video game release now in the works as well. What are you hoping to see in the new The Apothecary Diaries movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 'Killed Again, Mr. Detective?' Manga's Inaba Launches New Manga
content:
The November issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine revealed last Friday that manga creator Inaba will launch a new manga titled Nukedashi ~Renai Kinshi no Kotō de Ore wa Ajin Joshi to Chome Chome Suru~ (Break Free ~Doing This and That With Demi-Human Girls on a Lonely Island Where Romance is Forbidden) in this year's 37th issue of Kadokawa 's Young Dragon Age magazine on October 26.

Inaba 's manga adaptation of writer Teniwoha and artist Riichu 's Killed Again, Mr. Detective? ( Mata Korosarete Shimatta no desu ne, Tantei-sama ) light novel series launched on Kadokawa 's Dra Dra Flat manga site in July 2022, and it ended in its second compiled book volume, which shipped in March 2024. Yen Press published the first volume in English in August 2025, and the second and final volume on January 20. The original light novels inspired a television anime that debuted on April 20 earlier this year. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at New Fights & Forms
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has officially kicked off its return with new episodes this Fall, and the newest preview for Episode 3 of the anime is setting up some big new fights and transformations. Black Clover has returned to screens after five long years, and with it fans have gotten to see some of the big moments from the final arcs of Yuki Tabata’s original manga come to life. This means showing off some of the key transformations fans have been waiting a long time to see adapted.

With Black Clover Season 2 picking back up with the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, the Magic Knights have been quickly thrown into the fights against the Dark Triad in order to stop the Advent of Qliphoth ritual. With training for a few days before this big rematch, the episodes thus far have already revealed some big power ups for each of the characters . And that’s set to continue with the next episode as Black Clover Season 2 Episode 3 has released early preview images you can find below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 3 Reveals First Look Preview

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 3 is titled “The Black Guardian,” and will be making its debut in Japan on October 17th, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories. With the first two episodes seeing the Clover Kingdom enter their respective fights against the Dark Triad, the end of the second episode teased that things would be getting more intense with the early arrival of some powerful new devils from the underworld. But that’s not all that’s going down as there’s an entire war to keep track of.

Not only does it tease that the Spade Kingdom’s resistance army will be fighting against demonic threats, but it seems like the Clover Kingdom is also in danger with the synopsis for the episode, “Meanwhile, a demon appears in the Clover Kingdom, where the captains are absent, and the people face a life-threatening crisis,” the synopsis reads. “It is Asta’s anti-magic power, gained through mastering “Union ,” that saves them from this crisis. Amidst all this, the power of the demons of the Dark Triad finally reaches 100%…”

What to Know for Black Clover Season 2

At the rate in which Black Clover ‘s anime is adapting the Spade Kingdom Raid chapters (and the fact that these chapters were relatively short to begin with), it’s clear that this second season won’t be anywhere near as long as the 170 episode long first season was . The anime has yet to confirm how many episodes this new season will be running for, but it’s likely going to be a single cour of episodes considering that all the series really has to adapt are a string of fights that are relatively quick in pace.

This means each episode of Black Clover Season 2 is going to be jam packed with a ton of action to keep an eye out for. There have been a ton of new transformations revealed in just the first two episodes alone, and that’s going to continue even further with this third episode and beyond. It’s what fans have been excited to see all this time, so what are you hoping to see in Black Clover ‘s next episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Erica Sakurazawa Launches New Manga on November 6
content:
The November issue of Shodensha 's Feel Young magazine announced on Thursday that manga creator Erica Sakurazawa will launch a new manga titled Watashi no Manga (Mayoi) Michi (My [Lost] Road to Manga) in the magazine's next issue on November 6. The manga will feature behind-the-scenes essays from "that era."

Sakurazawa launched the Paris 1921―Sasori-za no Onna to Shishi-za no Onna (Paris 1921―Scorpio Woman and Leo Woman, image right) manga on Sekaibunkasha's Kateigaho.com website in June 2024. The manga centers on French painter Marie Laurencin and French fashion designer Coco Chanel. Sekaibunkasha published one volume of the manga in October 2025.

Sakurazawa's Koi wa Okane ja Kaemasen (Can't Buy Love with Money) manga ended in its fourth compiled book volume in November 2022. The manga launched in Shueisha 's office YOU magazine in January 2021.

Tokyopop published Sakurazawa's Angel , Angel Nest , The Aromatic Bitters , Between the Sheets , Nothing But Loving You , and The Rules of Love stories in a series called Erica Sakurazawa Collected Works in 2003-2004.

Sakurazawa's yuri manga Love Vibes inspired a live-action film titled Kakera: A Piece of Our Life in 2010.

title: Blue Thermal's Kana Ozawa Announces New Manga
content:
Manga creator Kana Ozawa announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account on Thursday a new manga titled Ao Sansan (Blue Brilliance), which will start serialization in December. Other details such as the manga's publication medium will be revealed at a later date. Ozawa stated that the manga is a new story that they have been developing for the past few years.

Ozawa launched the Blue Moment manga on Kadokawa 's Comic Bridge Online website in November 2018. Kadokawa published the manga's second compiled book volume in September 2020. The manga inspired a live-action series in 2024.

Ozawa's Blue Thermal -Aonagi Daigaku Taiiku-kai Kōkū-bu- (Aonagi College Sports Festival Aviation Club) manga ran in Shinchosha 's Monthly Comic @Bunch magazine from April 2014 to November 2017, and Shinchosha published five compiled book volumes for the manga (the manga's fifth volume mentions that only the "first part" of the story has concluded). Ozawa launched a prequel manga titled Blue Thermal : First Flight on the LINE Manga app in November 2021, and ended it in January 2022. Shinchosha published the manga's one compiled book volume in February 2022.

contentBlocks.text: Ozawa launched the Blue Moment manga on Kadokawa 's Comic Bridge Online website in November 2018. Kadokawa published the manga's second compiled book volume in September 2020. The manga inspired a live-action series in 2024.

Ozawa's Blue Thermal -Aonagi Daigaku Taiiku-kai Kōkū-bu- (Aonagi College Sports Festival Aviation Club) manga ran in Shinchosha 's Monthly Comic @Bunch magazine from April 2014 to November 2017, and Shinchosha published five compiled book volumes for the manga (the manga's fifth volume mentions that only the "first part" of the story has concluded). Ozawa launched a prequel manga titled Blue Thermal : First Flight on the LINE Manga app in November 2021, and ended it in January 2022. Shinchosha published the manga's one compiled book volume in February 2022.
The main manga's anime film adaptation premiered in Japan in March 2022. Eleven Arts and Shout! Factory released the movie on home video.

title: It’s Official, Nue’s Exorcist Is Finally Getting Its Own Anime – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
It’s been three years since Nue’s Exorcist first made its debut with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and now it’s finally confirmed to be getting its own anime adaptation coming our way next year. When looking at the current status of the magazine on a whole, there are a few series that have been largely ignored for the past few years despite being steady hits for the magazine . But even with that in mind, Nue’s Exorcist fans have been hoping to see the series making its TV anime debut in the future.

Things got a lot more promising recently as not only did Nue’s Exorcist recently celebrate its third anniversary, but it was one of the projects touted to have something to share as part of Shueisha’s newest Jump Press event to cap off the weekend . This proved to be the case as Nue’s Exorcist has now officially revealed the first look at its new anime, and you can check out the first trailer and poster for the series below ahead of its launch next year.

Nue’s Exorcist Anime Confirmed for Summer 2027 Release

Nue’s Exorcist is currently scheduled to make its debut sometime in Summer 2027, but a more concrete release date or potential international streaming release plans have yet to be announced as of this time. But this first reveal confirmed the production staff as Hiroyuki Hashimoto will be directing the new anime series for Studio Hibari, Hiroshi Seko will be providing the scripts, Shunpei Mochizuki will be providing the character designers, Takayuki Yamaguchi will be serving as sound director and MONACA will be composing the music.

This announcement also revealed the first three members of the voice cast with Kaito Miura as Gakuro Yajima, Saori Onishi as Nue, and Sayumi Suzushiro as Kazusa Suo with more members of the cast to be revealed at a later date. We’re likely going to get more updates for the series later this December during Jump Festa 2027 . Nue’s Exorcist has been confirmed to be one of the major franchises with something to share during the big weekend, and now it’s even more exciting to look forward to since a new anime is in production for it.

Why Nue’s Exorcist is a Big Deal

Reports of a potential new anime for Nue’s Exorcist started popping up earlier this month when the franchise had established a new website domain , and thankfully it was confirmed to be in the works soon after. But even without these reports helping to further spark up the hope of a new anime, fans have been hoping to see it happen either way considering how much has gone down for the series within its three years of serialization thus far. There’s finally enough material to serve as a base for a proper anime adaptation to get started.

The series introduces fans to Gakuto, who’s quickly thrown into the world of exorcists after coming across the titular Nue at school. It’s a nostalgic kind of series with not only a massive roster of characters (with the majority of them eventually growing romantic feelings for Gakuto in the process), and several power ups, transformations, weapon reveals and more . If this new anime can bring it all to life, we’re looking at our next big Shonen Jump anime hit here.

Are you excited to see Nue’s Exorcist finally making its anime debut? What are you most looking forward to seeing in action? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
